thesis: HOLD the separate cryptocurrency paper portfolio in cash this cycle. Verified AUTONOM state on November 8 shows $1,000 cash, zero positions, zero pending orders and two processed crypto HOLD decisions (November 6 and 7), with no simulated crypto fills. The November 7 completed UTC Coinbase candle, collected November 8 at 09:01 UTC, marked BTC at $75,753.96, ETH $2,236.55, SOL $89.67, ADA $0.18157 and LINK $10.813. These are prior-day closes, not executable November 8 quotes. BTC's November 7 close is only about 0.0303% above November 6's $75,731.04, insufficient to establish a trend reversal after recent sharp declines. The passive BTC benchmark started November 5 at $75,969.06 (0.013163253566649371 units) and was $997.168584 on November 7, while the cash-only portfolio remained $1,000; the 0.2831 percentage-point lead is a very short-sample outcome, not evidence of skill. Contemporary November 8 reporting by crypto.news says BTC remained below $76,000 on Sunday, altcoins suffered significant weekly losses, and U.S. spot BTC ETFs had approximately $1.28 billion in reported outflows during November 2–6. Benzinga separately reports Friday BTC ETF outflows above $411 million attributed to SoSoValue. These are third-party flow estimates, not independently audited on-chain flows, and their timing/causal interpretation is uncertain. Another November 8 Reuters report describes a fresh decline in crypto prices amid political/regulatory and security worries; without a timestamp-aligned verified Coinbase close for the ongoing November 8 UTC candle, it should not be used as an execution quote. With broad risk-off pressure, no verifiable positive catalyst or tested short-horizon edge and no assets to SELL, opening a new spot BUY is not justified merely because prices have fallen. Preserve optionality and reassess with completed later UTC bars and corroborated evidence. This is a prospective decision only, not a fill or a prediction of certain further losses.
risk_notes: Opportunity cost is substantial if BTC or supported altcoins rebound rapidly; HOLD avoids exposure but may underperform the passive BTC benchmark. Weekend liquidity, abrupt news, exchange-security risks, policy shifts and ETF-flow revisions can change the picture quickly. Reported ETF flows are off-chain fund figures and should not be confused with verified blockchain movements. No authenticated live executable quotes, independent order-book depth, or independently verified on-chain signals were obtained; the repository's November 7 closes are stale for November 8 trading. A future spot BUY would be limited to 35% of portfolio equity in any one asset, with modeled 0.10% fee plus 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, and could execute only on a completed UTC daily bar beginning after engine first-seen time. No leverage, shorts, derivatives, transfers, real-money orders or stock-account changes.
